proof_scope: the runner's own gates exercised through run.sh against crafted manifests, plus a real report-artifact readback; dogfoods claim-based readiness (#1445), the real-E2E contract (#1446), and seam coverage (#1448)

claims.proves: agentic-evals holds its own fail-closed, teardown, claim-separation, evidence-qualification, and report-emission capabilities to the same evidence contract it enforces on other skills
claims.does_not_prove: the browser/persistence incidents backfilled as gaps in other skills, which require live provider/session boundaries

what_was_exercised: run.sh invoked against fault-injected manifests and one passing manifest whose emitted report is read back as an artifact
what_remains_unverified: cross-skill live browser and persistence capabilities (tracked as UNMAPPED incidents in fixtures/regressions.json)

capability_claims.description: run exits non-zero unless every required case is READY, and --report-only opts out
a timed-out case terminates its process group and leaves no orphan
passing deterministic cases cannot satisfy a required live_e2e slot (#1445)
a live_e2e case with no independent readback is downgraded and cannot satisfy a live slot (#1446)
run emits a machine-readable report whose readiness field an independent reader can verify

cases.name: gate-fails-closed-on-failed-required-case
command: R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; D=$(mktemp -d); printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"f","type":"positive","command":["bash","-c","exit 3"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/f.json"; $R run "$D/f.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -ne 0 && $R run "$D/f.json" --report-only >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo GATE_OK

cases.name: timed-out-case-leaves-no-orphan
command: R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; D=$(mktemp -d); printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"t","type":"adversarial","timeout_seconds":3,"command":["bash","-c","sleep 300 & sleep 300"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/t.json"; $R run "$D/t.json" --report-only 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;t=json.load(sys.stdin)['cases'][0]['trials'][0];assert t['timed_out'] and t['orphan_pids_after_teardown']==[];print('NO_ORPHAN')"

cases.name: deterministic-passes-cannot-satisfy-required-live
command: R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals; $R run fixtures/selftest/det_only_missing_live.json --report-only 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);c=d['capability_readiness']['claims'][0];assert d['readiness']!='READY' and c['verdict']=='PARTIALLY_PROVEN' and c['missing_evidence']==['live_e2e'];print('CLASS_SEPARATION_OK')"

cases.name: pseudo-live-without-readback-is-downgraded
command: R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals; $R run fixtures/selftest/pseudo_live.json --report-only 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);case=d['cases'][0];assert case['live_qualified'] is False and case['effective_evidence_class']=='fault_injected_deterministic' and d['readiness']!='READY';print('REAL_E2E_CONTRACT_OK')"

cases.name: run-emits-a-readable-report-artifact
command: R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; D=$(mktemp -d); printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"p","type":"positive","command":["bash","-c","true"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/p.json"; mkdir -p out; $R run "$D/p.json" --output out/report.json >/dev/null 2>&1
